name: fleet-rollout-smoke
title: Roll the durable lane out to the 8 fleet consumers with a per-repo smoke PR
description: Deploy the routed review lane to the eight fleet consumer repositories, of which zero currently carry either the discovery descriptor or the durable review workflow. For each repository install the setup descriptor and the workflow_dispatch sd-review.yml lane through the sd-ai-command-pack fleet-refresh mechanism, then open one smoke pull request per repository and confirm the sd-github-review/receipt Check Run is published against it. Sequenced after the installer task, which is what makes the descriptor and the durable lane installable in the first place.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Blocked on 08-08-installer-durable-lane. Until the installer emits the descriptor and the sd-review.yml lane, a rollout has nothing to roll out, and this repository's own rollout needs the descriptor relocation off the consumer discovery path. See prd.md Notes.
